title: Graded kernel action from local lifts, without finite generation
statement: Let X be Noetherian, I a quasi-coherent ideal, and F a coherent formal module [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Let A be any graded sheaf algebra on the pieces B_n of [def-weil-pbc-formal-kernel-graded-pieces], with the degree-zero quotient unit and multiplication induced by products of ideal-power representatives. There exists a graded sheaf module M [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures] on the kernel pieces K_n. For all m,n,U, sections a in I^m(U), x in K_n(U), and t in F_(m+n+1)(U) reducing to the inclusion of x, the inclusion of M.act of the class of a and x is a times t. No finite-generation assertion is included.

source.place: Lemma 087Z, affine proof via Lemma 087W and Section 0EHN; constituent of the parent existence proof, expanded in the Lean docstring.

proof.text: Induct on the number of successive reductions to obtain F_l/I^r F_l=F_r for l>=r>=1. The quotient descriptions make every transition an epimorphism. A local lift of x in K_n to level m+n+1 lies in I^n at that level when n>0; at n=0 no constraint is needed. Multiplication by I^m has zero reduction to level m+n, hence factors through K_(m+n).

Differences of lifts lie in I^(n+1)F_(m+n+1); differences of coefficients lie in I^(m+1). Products of these differences with the other factor vanish by level m+n+1 annihilation. Local lifts of quotient coefficients and system sections exist by sheaf epimorphy. Independence, bilinearity and restriction compatibility give action maps on all opens by gluing.

Check associativity locally after lifting to one common high level, using the given representative multiplication formula for A: both sides become (ab)t=a(bt). Its given quotient unit acts as 1. Monic kernel inclusions and sheaf uniqueness prove the graded module laws and the formula for every existing lift.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 087Z, construction and affine proof; local-lift and sheaf descent details expanded by Q3.

lean.statement:
theorem formalKernel_graded_action_exists {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F : CoherentFormalModule X I)
    (A : GradedSheafAlgebra (formalAssociatedGradedPiece I))
    (hunit : A.unit = formalAssociatedGradedπ I 0)
    (hmul : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens)
        (a : (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι m).1.val.obj (op U))
        (b : (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).1.val.obj (op U)),
        ∃ c : (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι (m + n)).1.val.obj (op U),
          (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι (m + n)).2.val.app (op U) c =
            (@id Γ(X, U) ((Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι m).2.val.app (op U) a)) *
              (@id Γ(X, U) ((Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).2.val.app (op U) b)) ∧
          A.mul m n U ((formalAssociatedGradedπ I m).val.app (op U) a)
            ((formalAssociatedGradedπ I n).val.app (op U) b) =
              (formalAssociatedGradedπ I (m + n)).val.app (op U) c) :
    ∃ M : GradedSheafModule A (formalKernelPiece F),
        ∀ (m n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens)
          (a : (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι m).1.val.obj (op U))
          (x : (formalKernelPiece F n).val.obj (op U))
          (t : (F.obj.obj (op (m + n))).val.obj (op U)),
          (F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_left n m)).op).val.app (op U) t =
            (formalKernelι F n).val.app (op U) x →
          (formalKernelι F (m + n)).val.app (op U)
            (M.act m n U ((formalAssociatedGradedπ I m).val.app (op U) a) x) =
              (@id Γ(X, U) ((Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι m).2.val.app (op U) a)) • t
